name: Hillworth Park under 5s play area
text: A play area for under-5s just inside the main entrance of Hillworth Park, run by Devizes Town Council.

name: Hillworth Park under 11s play area
text: A play area for older children with a small football area, in the field next to Hillworth Park's formal gardens. Run by Devizes Town Council.

name: The Green play area
text: A play area for under-12s with modern equipment, next to the Crammer pond. Run by Devizes Town Council.

name: Avon Road play area
text: A half-hectare play area for under-11s with a mini basketball court, trim trail, football goal and junior pitch. Run by Devizes Town Council.
